evidence_sentences: SpaceX is an American space technology company headquartered at the Starbase development site in Starbase, Texas.
Since its founding in 2002, the company has made numerous advances in rocket propulsion, reusable launch vehicles, human spaceflight and satellite constellation technology.
SpaceX was founded by Elon Musk in 2002 with a vision of decreasing the costs of space launches, paving the way to a self-sustaining colony on Mars.
In 2008, Falcon 1 successfully launched into orbit after three failed launch attempts.
By 2012, SpaceX finished all COTS test flights and began delivering Commercial Resupply Services missions to the International Space Station.
The company demonstrated the first successful first-stage landing in 2015 and re-launch of the first stage in 2017.
As of May 2025, the company's Falcon 9 rockets have landed and flown again more than 450 times, reaching 1–3 launches a week.
In 2019, the first operational satellite of the Starlink internet satellite constellation came online.
